theme_strategy.description: A premium, cinematic AI-assistant experience with a signature animated glowing orb, deep blues/violets with cyan accents. Material 3 spirit with adaptive glassmorphism.

glassmorphism.description: Adaptive Material 3 Glassmorphism restricted to floating overlays (Bottom Nav, Sticky Headers, Dialogs) to maintain performance and readability.
glassmorphism.classes_dark: bg-[#131B2B]/70 backdrop-blur-2xl backdrop-saturate-150 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)]
glassmorphism.classes_light: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-2xl backdrop-saturate-150 border border-black/5 shadow-sm

ai_orb.description: Central visual anchor representing Sarvam AI. Uses Framer Motion for breathing/pulsing effects.
ai_orb.implementation: Framer Motion animated div. Pulse scaling (0.95 to 1.05), slow rotation (360deg over 20s), box-shadow glow transition between Cyan and Violet.

surface_cards.description: Solid surfaces for dense content. 1px border. No glass to ensure WCAG text readability.

bottom_nav.style: Floating glassmorphic pill at the bottom of the screen. Fixed position, z-50. Padding-4.
bottom_nav.active_state: Primary color icon with subtle under-glow.
bottom_nav.classes: fixed bottom-6 left-4 right-4 rounded-full flex justify-around items-center h-16

assistant_card.interactions: Hover/Press: slight scale down (-translate-y-1 or scale-95) and border color shift to primary/50.
assistant_card.layout: Flex column, gap-3, p-5. Icon top left (lucide-react), title, short description.
assistant_card.badge: For 'Coming Soon' or 'Beta', use a tiny uppercase badge top-right.

chat_bubble.user: bg-primary text-white rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm ml-auto max-w-[85%] p-4 shadow-sm
chat_bubble.ai: bg-surface border border-border text-foreground rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm mr-auto max-w-[85%] p-4 shadow-sm
chat_bubble.streaming: Add a typing indicator or subtle pulse at the end of the text.

input_bar.style: Floating glass pill above bottom nav or fixed at bottom in chat view.
input_bar.layout: Flex row, items-center, gap-2. Contains text input, attach (clip), and voice (mic) prominent button.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-surfaceHighlight text-foreground rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-semibold hover:bg-border transition-transform active:scale-95

layouts.splash_onboarding: Full screen dark background. Massive AI orb in center. Fade-in typography. Swipe to continue.
layouts.dashboard: Mobile-first standard. Top: sticky glass header + small orb + Profile. Middle: Search bar + Scrollable Categories + Bento grid of 40+ assistants. Bottom: Padding for nav.
layouts.chat_screen: Top: Glass header with Assistant Info + Back button. Middle: Scrollable chat list with generous padding. Bottom: Sticky input area.
layouts.voice_mode: Immersive full screen. Massive pulsing AI Orb in center. Audio waveform at bottom. Transparent controls overlay.
layouts.memory_screen: List layout grouped by categories. Edit/Delete swipe actions.
layouts.settings_screen: Grouped list items, solid cards, clear toggles.

motion.page_transition: Fade and slight slide-up (y: 20 -> 0, opacity: 0 -> 1) using Framer Motion.
motion.staggered_list: Assistants grid items fade in sequentially (staggerChildren: 0.05).
motion.micro_interactions: Tap states scale down to 0.95. Haptic feedback simulated visually with quick ripple or opacity flash.

ai_orb_texture.description: Abstract dark orb with glowing rings for Splash and Voice screens

dark_texture.description: Subtle futuristic wavy texture for background overlays to kill digital flatness

instructions_to_main_agent: Build as a responsive mobile web app using React and Tailwind CSS. Use .js/.jsx extensions.
Simulate mobile app feel: disable text selection (select-none) on UI elements, hide scrollbars (scrollbar-hide).
Use Framer Motion for the animated AI Orb, page transitions, and list staggering.
Implement adaptive Material 3 Glassmorphism ONLY on floating elements (Bottom Nav, sticky headers, dialogs). Keep main content cards solid for text legibility.
DO NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays. Always use backdrop-blur + semi-transparent fill + 1px border.
Ensure all fonts are highly legible on mobile. Add tracking-tight to headings.
Use lucide-react for all 40+ categorized AI assistant icons.
All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes (kebab-case, role-based).
Build a unified AI chat brain interface that accepts a system prompt depending on the selected assistant.
Ensure the design supports light and dark themes via Tailwind's dark mode classes.
Structure bottom navigation fixed at the bottom with proper safe-area padding.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use high-end glass-morphism effects (backdrop-blur-2xl + backdrop-saturate-150 + subtle inner borders) only on overlays.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭) for icons. Always use lucide-react.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. Cramped designs look cheap.
Avoid 'transition: all'. Target specific properties (e.g., transition-transform, transition-colors).
Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` to global CSS.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glassmorphism has minimum 4.5:1 contrast. Use Text Shadow if necessary.
accessibility.focus: Focus rings must be visible. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2
accessibility.aria: Add aria-labels to icon-only buttons (Mic, Send, Nav items).
